name: 43592-longdecode-minimaxm2230b-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 on one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), sm90, single node, one in-process engine.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, EP off, CP off, one vLLM engine. TP4 rather than TP8: the expert intermediate size is 1536, which divides by 4 into a multiple of the checkpoint's FP8 block size of 128 and by 8 does not.
load_profile: Concurrent closed loop, 16 streams, bounded at 144 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup 32 requests by completion, no cooldown, so about 128 are measured. Static seed 43592.
workload: Synthetic single-turn text: every request is exactly 8192 prompt tokens in and 1024 out, greedy at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos, prefix caching off. Lengths are exact rather than a band (min = max = mean on both), and the chat template adds its own tokens, so the engine reports somewhat more than 8192.
purpose: A long-context report generator producing 1024-token answers from 8192-token briefs for 16 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# The served engine configuration for this setup. The request shape and the load profile live
# in scenario.json; the one environment variable lives in tuned.yaml.
model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7
tensor-parallel-size: 4
trust-remote-code: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# `quantization` is deliberately NOT set: the checkpoint carries its own `quantization_config`
# (fp8, block [128, 128], dynamic activations) and the engine selects from it. `kv-cache-dtype`
# is likewise untouched, so the KV cache is bf16 like the activations.
